item.text:
**8B.10 Research Note: Joko Widodo, 2024**

Bottom line: **mixed, but slightly closer on the stated development / international-policy program than at the start of 2024**. The year produced real short-term policy wins and visible delivery, but the strongest counterevidence shows patronage, dynastic maneuvering, and unresolved rights abuses that weaken the case for durable progress.

- [Indonesia’s economy projected to remain resilient](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/24/indonesia-economy-projected-to-remain-resilient) - World Bank, 2024-06-24. The Bank credited Indonesia’s robust macro framework with attracting investment and forecast steady growth, with a call for prudent, credible, transparent policy. This supports a claim that Jokowi was still advancing a technocratic pro-growth program under external headwinds. **IDs:** 8B.10

- [Macro Poverty Outlook for Indonesia: October 2024 Datasheet](https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099026110152411280) - World Bank, 2024-10-02. Indonesia was growing around 5%, poverty fell from 17.5% to 15.8% in 2024, and external financing/currency pressures moderated, though job quality lagged. This is the strongest evidence that he ended 2024 nearer to the economic-development objective than he began it. **IDs:** 8B.10

- [Jokowi orders audit of Indonesia’s data centres after cyberattack](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3268495/jokowi-orders-audit-indonesias-data-centres-after-cyberattack) - Reuters via South China Morning Post, 2024-06-28. After a major ransomware attack, Jokowi ordered an audit rather than denial or mass punishment. That is limited but real evidence of adaptive crisis management after an external shock. **IDs:** 8B.10

- [President Jokowi inaugurates Plaza Seremoni Sumbu Kebangsaan in Nusantara](https://presidenri.go.id/siaran-pers/presiden-jokowi-resmikan-plaza-seremonial-sumbu-kebangsaan-di-ibu-kota-nusantara/) - Presidential Secretariat of the Republic of Indonesia, 2024-08-14. The official page presents a tangible Nusantara milestone as visible progress on the flagship capital-relocation project. This supports a short-term delivery reading for a core policy objective. **IDs:** 8B.10

- [Indonesia joins countries prohibiting nuclear weapons](https://en.antaranews.com/news/327307/indonesia-joins-countries-prohibiting-nuclear-weapons) - ANTARA News, 2024-09-25. Indonesia formally submitted ratification of the TPNW, which is concrete arms-control diplomacy and a real international-norms achievement. This supports the international-influence / de-escalation side of the lens. **IDs:** 8B.10

- [Indonesia leader accused of bias, interference in presidential election](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-leader-accused-of-bias-interference-in-presidential-election/1948656/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-02-01. Reuters reported mounting criticism over Jokowi’s perceived non-neutrality and public alignment with Prabowo while his son was on the ticket. This is direct evidence for succession shaping and also informs **4B.2**. **IDs:** 8B.10, 4B.2

- [Indonesia shelves plan to revise election law as protests rage](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/protests-across-indonesia-as-parliament-delays-change-to-election-law-3582501) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-08-22. The proposed rule changes were widely seen as helping Jokowi’s youngest son and provoking protests, while security forces used tear gas and water cannon. This is strong evidence of power-consolidation behavior and also informs **4B.2**. **IDs:** 8B.10, 4B.2

- [Analysis-A decade of Jokowi: Indonesia’s democracy icon leaves illiberal legacy, critics say](https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-10-14. Reuters’ year-end synthesis says Jokowi left strong growth and infrastructure, but also patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity. This is the best single summary of the mixed record and also informs **7B.9**. **IDs:** 8B.10, 7B.9

- [Indonesia: Racism, Discrimination Against Indigenous Papuans](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/18/indonesia-racism-discrimination-against-indigenous-papuans) - Human Rights Watch, 2024-09-18. HRW reports arbitrary arrests, torture, extrajudicial killings, mass displacement, and weak accountability in Papua. This is the strongest negative evidence that 2024 did not make the state clearly more protective or more durable in the long run. **IDs:** 8B.10

Gap: I did **not** find strong 2024 evidence of a new ideological program beyond development, capital relocation, and a restrained / arms-control-oriented foreign policy. The hardest evidence is instead about the cost side: family advantage, patronage, and weak accountability.
